newsitem.title: USA: AIG Risk Finance offers new liability cover.
newsitem.headline: AIG Risk Finance offers new liability cover.

text.p: American International Group Inc said its AIG Risk Finance division has introduced a policy that provides coverage for third party financial losses resulting from the use of independent contractors.
The policy provides vicarious liability and general supervision coverage for a corporation when the insured becomes liable for the errors and omissions of an outside contractor, the company said.
The policy also insures against direct allegations of failure to supervise outside contractors.
Limits of liability are available up to $25 million.

Even absent a claim, the Vicarious Liability and General Supervision of Service Providers insurance policy may cover losses to an insured's customer or client until recovery is obtained from the service provider. The policy also will provide coverage if the service provider does not or cannot live up to indemnities promised to the insured.

"With outsourcing fast becoming standard practice among America's major corporations, legal experts anticipate that the number of vicarious liability lawsuits will increase," said AIG Risk Finance president Tobey Russ.

"As a result, most companies require coverage beyond general and professional liability policies, which fall short in covering the different exposures that may arise from the use of independent contractors," he said.
"This new policy fills the gap by addressing financial and performance related losses," he said.
